scope: public Push-T clean single-seed controlled BC/ACT training; not guidewire validation
sampler: uniform training-frame anchors with replacement; torch CPU generator seeded sampler_seed + zero-based update index
selection: final step 100000 only; validation is monitoring, no best-checkpoint selection or early stopping
normalization: saved train-only state/action population mean/std; fixed ImageNet image statistics; epsilon 1e-8

act.source: official LeRobot 0.4.4 full ACT via pinned factory
act.loss: unchanged official L1 plus 10 KL including original padding reduction

fairness: same frame anchors, split, normalization, batch size, update budget and random-init seed; architecture, loss, learning rates and future-action supervision differ and must be reported; official pretrained DP is external reference only
precision: float32 CUDA; deterministic algorithms; no AMP/TF32

validation.prediction: first action of a fresh observation-only prediction; no target-conditioned ACT latent
validation.frames: all 2162 validation frames in fixed order

efficiency: log model parameters, measured batch gradient-check timing, update wall time, peak allocated CUDA memory and checkpoint storage; equal updates are not equal FLOPs or wall time
robustness: future frozen paired image corruption, only after clean baseline scores; not authorized by this protocol
ablation_and_xai: no innovation or XAI contribution claimed in this baseline stage; world-model work remains paused
execution: training requires explicit --execute and matching successful preflight; long job is user-run; no environment rollout from the trainer
